scope: Python child subprocess diagnostic tests only; no Docker, kernel or real host launched; no storage acceptance credit

diagnosticContract.directories: 0700, current effective operator UID; existing symlink, wrong-owner or group/world-accessible roots rejected before launch
diagnosticContract.publicError: fixed operation label, command SHA-256, status and exit code or timeout, evidence paths, byte counts and hashes only
diagnosticContract.rawOutput: exact bytes, private; never copy raw diagnostic files into public acceptance evidence without a separate review
diagnosticContract.failureSemantics: nonzero remains RuntimeError with returncode; timeout remains subprocess.TimeoutExpired; launch errors preserve errno/class; no retry
diagnosticContract.diagnosticWriteFailure: original child status remains failure and diagnosticStorageError records safe error type/errno; no claim that unpersisted bytes were retained
